research_question: Can a carrier selected without benchmark semantics restore exact local-model output, and can target isolation plus deterministic local-scope perception preserve relational request inheritance without spreading it into negated targets?
project_effect: Create a small, reliable internal pragmatic-commitment module for supported VRM actions. It is not a benchmark answer table and does not change the right-brain persona model.

scientific_and_implementation_basis.name: Ollama structured outputs
scientific_and_implementation_basis.design_use: Compare schema carriers and include the exact schema in the format-only prompt, as recommended by the official documentation.

scientific_and_implementation_basis.name: Ollama tool calling
scientific_and_implementation_basis.design_use: Evaluate a single internal classification tool call as one carrier candidate without executing a physical VRM action.

scientific_and_implementation_basis.name: value-agnostic conversational semantic parsing
scientific_and_implementation_basis.design_use: Keep deterministic grounded values separate from the model's pragmatic relation judgment.

stage_1_format_probe.task: Copy an explicitly supplied source_label through each carrier; do not infer commitment from an utterance.

carrier_definitions.scalar_enum_schema: Top-level JSON string constrained to the six commitment labels.
carrier_definitions.two_field_object_schema: Object with commitment plus constant contract_ack=v44.
carrier_definitions.nested_label_schema: Object with classification.commitment as the only semantic value.
carrier_definitions.tool_call_schema: Exactly one non-executing record_commitment tool call with a commitment argument.

stage_1_format_probe.fair_latency_protocol: Before scoring each carrier, unload the model, run one fixed unscored warm-up through that same carrier, and then run all 12 scored cases.
stage_1_format_probe.selection_rule: Eligible carriers must pass every gate. Select the eligible carrier with the lowest median latency; break an exact tie by lexical carrier id. If none is eligible, stop before semantic development.

conditions.target_only_control: Selected carrier with the exact V42 target-only user payload and no relational guidance.
conditions.all_targets_relational: Add all grounded targets and the V43 general relational rules.
conditions.isolated_other_targets: Move all non-focus targets into context_only_other_targets and explicitly prohibit classifying or outputting them.
conditions.isolated_scope_signals_candidate: Keep target isolation and add deterministic per-anchor local scope reasons from the existing V38 grounding layer.

causal_comparisons.target_only_to_all_targets: Effect of relational context and general relational rules.
causal_comparisons.all_targets_to_isolated_other_targets: Effect of separating the focus target from read-only context.
causal_comparisons.isolated_other_targets_to_isolated_scope: Effect of deterministic local negation/cancellation perception.

stage_2_semantic_conditions.scope_signal_source: Existing general V38 anchor scope detector; no gold commitment, expected call, case family, or benchmark answer is supplied.

decision_rule: Stage 1 selects a carrier mechanically. Stage 2 runs only after that selection. Only a full isolated_scope_signals_candidate development pass can authorize freezing a new 48-case holdout; development results alone never authorize runtime.
